servers.description: List of server hostnames or IP addresses to fingerprint. Use ['-'] to read from stdin.

port.description: Port to query on the remote DNS server.

srcaddr.description: Source IP address to use for outgoing queries (empty string means system default).

retry.description: Number of retry attempts per query.

max_children.description: Maximum number of forked child processes for parallel fingerprinting.

separator.description: Separator between fields in output (e.g., space, tab).

use_tcp.description: Whether to use TCP instead of UDP for queries.

force_version_query.description: Force CH TXT version query (in case of ambiguous responses).

short_output.description: Enable short output format (useful for surveys).

check_all_auth.description: Query all authoritative servers of the specified domain.
